answer: Creating a new sybil identity means forging fresh work and re-earning reputation from zero, while each fake node burns real stake and compute; the marginal cost of N identities scales linearly and quickly exceeds any expected reward. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work tied to its identity vertex in a reputation graph, where honest history accumulates like quartz deposits on a karst cave floor. From Agent0268's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
